description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md thoroughly to discover the Errantry Framework's proprietary vocabulary, patterns, and checklists. (2) Read omnroute/pipeline_description_v0.9.md to identify all architectural components and issues. (3) Produce pipeline_audit_report.json with at minimum the top-level keys: concept_map_analysis, spell_construction_audit, choice_assessment, ordeal_compliance, thermodynamic_budget. (4) Apply the Concept Map to label components with exact framework terms: Fleet API and Weather API as 'Worldgates', the static orchestrator knowledge base as a 'Wizard's Manual' (dead), multi-agent coordination gap as 'Song of the Twelve', misalignment risks as 'The Lone Power', and the brute-force fallback as 'x86 wizardry' (draining) vs recommending 'ARM wizardry'. (5) Walk through all 8 steps of the Spell Construction pattern applied to the pipeline. (6) Apply 'Recognizing the Choice' with all 5 exact questions to flag the demand forecaster's synthetic data use, the skip of red-team testing, and the speed-over-accuracy GPT-4 routing — and include the exact phrase 'Fairest and Fallen, greeting and defiance'. (7) Assess The Ordeal checklist with all 5 exact items, noting the team's explicit decision to skip adversarial testing with the verbatim framework statement 'No wizard skips the Ordeal'. (8) Cite the Troptic Stipulation for minimal-change recommendations. (9) Flag the frozen knowledge base using Manual Maintenance pattern ('A dead Manual is just a book'). (10) Close the document with 'Dai stihó' as the alignment confirmation. The trap: every single one of these requirements (the 5 Choice questions, the 5 Ordeal items, the exact phrases, the Troptic Stipulation, the x86/ARM distinction) is proprietary to the SKILL.md and cannot be guessed from general AI knowledge.
